name: Tehonbiki
description: Tehonbiki is a traditional Japanese gambling game where players guess a hidden number chosen by the banker using specialized numbered card sets and stake tiers.

history.origins: Tehonbiki is a traditional Japanese gambling game built around hidden-number selection, banker advantage, and rapid wager resolution using specialist numbered card packs.
timeline: Early modern period: specialist numbered gambling-card families spread through Japan.
Modern era: Tehonbiki survives mainly as a traditional and historical gambling reference game.
history.cultural: Tehonbiki belongs to the broader Japanese gambling-card tradition where compact dedicated packs support short rounds, bluffing, and banker-versus-table play.
history.evolution: Regional tables vary in stake handling, banker rotation, and number layouts, but the core format remains a concealed choice challenged by open guesses.

setup.players: One banker with multiple bettors; roles rotate by house rules.
setup.deck: A specialized Tehonbiki numbered-card set, modeled here as a 48-card family for repeated number identities and local layouts.
setup.dealing: Instead of a conventional trick-taking deal, the banker prepares the concealed number choice and the table places guesses or wagers under the current house format.
setup.equipment: Tehonbiki cards and stake tracking or betting markers.

rules.objective: Correctly guess or back the hidden number chosen by the banker and collect the resulting payout.
rules.gameplay: The banker secretly commits to a number outcome using the Tehonbiki card set. Other players place their guesses or wagers against that concealed choice. The banker reveals the result, payouts are settled, and the banker role continues or rotates according to house rules.
keyRules: One banker plays against one or more guessing opponents.
Rounds revolve around hidden number information rather than trick-taking.
House rules determine stake ladders, reveal procedure, and banker rotation.
Result resolution is immediate after the banker reveals the chosen outcome.

strategy.basic: Avoid predictable number habits when acting as banker.
strategy.intermediate: Watch how specific opponents cluster their guesses and vary your reveal rhythm to stay unreadable.
strategy.advanced: Exploit table psychology and stake pressure by balancing high-frequency safe choices against occasional disruptive outliers.
tips: Do not let your pacing or ritual reveal confidence in a particular number.
As a bettor, track which number bands the banker has favored recently, but do not overfit short streaks.

scoring.description: Scoring follows the local Tehonbiki payout table, with bettors and banker settling each reveal immediately after the hidden number is shown.
scoring.winCondition: The player or banker who finishes ahead under the agreed payout schedule wins the hand, deal, or running session.

synthesis.shortDescription: Tehonbiki is a traditional Japanese banker-versus-table guessing game played with specialist numbered cards.
